en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a rural village set in a valley with fields and forested hills in the background. In the foreground is a grassy slope with trees on the right side. Scattered houses and farm buildings are visible among trees in the middle distance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left reading "Sohland/Spree – An der Obersohlmlede" and a small code "K37155 B" appears in the bottom right.
